Section 5(L), 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, is before this Court seeking regular bail.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

sentences.text: 3. FIR in Crime No.4/2024 was registered by Sarjapura Police Station, Bengaluru District against the petitioner herein for the aforesaid offences, on the basis of first information dated 04.01.2024 received from respondent No.2 herein who is the mother of the victim girl, aged about 17 years 6 months as on the date of registration of FIR.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested and produced before the NC: 2024:KHC:45816 jurisdictional Court on 05.01.2024 and remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed against the petitioner for the aforesaid offences.
4. The bail application filed by the petitioner before the Sessions Court in Spl.C.No.195/2024 was dismissed on 29.05.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and the victim girl are in love.

The victim girl has not made any serious allegation against the petitioner either in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, or during the course of her examination-in-chief before the Trial Court, after she has attained the age of majority.
The petitioner who has no criminal antecedents is in custody for last 11 months.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP for respondent No.1 has opposed the petition.
He submits that the victim girl is NC: 2024:KHC:45816 a minor and therefore the alleged offences get attracted against the petitioner.
Accordingly, he prays to dismiss the petition.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 submits that the child born to the victim girl has died subsequently due to certain medical problems.
He submits that the petitioner and the victim girl are in love and they intend to marry each other.
He also submits that he has no objection to allow the petition.
8. The first informant had approached the police on 04.01.2024, after her minor daughter, who was medically examined was found to be pregnant.
On enquiry, the victim girl had informed the first informant that she and the petitioner were in love and as a result of their sexual relationship, she got pregnant.
9. During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 05.01.2024.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

The statement of the victim girl was recorded before the NC: 2024:KHC:45816 jurisdictional Magistrate on 09.01.2024, wherein she has stated that she was in love with the petitioner and they had consensual sex in their house, when there was nobody else at home.
10. Examination-in-chief of the victim girl was recorded before the Trial Court on 14.08.2024.
The material on record would go to show that, as on the said date, the victim girl had attained the age of majority.
She has not made any serious allegation against the petitioner and on the other hand, she has stated that she is in love with him.
As a result of their consensual sex, she got pregnant and subsequently, she gave birth to a child.

The petitioner who has no other criminal antecedents is in custody from 05.01.2024.
11.

Perusal of the statement made by the victim girl before the jurisdictional Magistrate under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, and also during chief examination of the victim girl as PW.1 before the Trial Court would go to show that, the victim girl has not made any serious allegation against the NC:
2024:KHC:45816 petitioner.
The prosecution in all has cited 20 charge sheet witnesses in the present case and only one witness has been partially examined till date.
12. Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

13. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER The Criminal Petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Spl.C.No.195/2024 pending before the Court of Addl. District & Sessions Judge-FTSC-III, Bengaluru Rural District,
arising out of Crime No.4/2024 registered by Sarjapura Police Station, Bengaluru District for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(f)(i)(n) of IPC, Section 5(L), 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, subject to the following conditions:
